paragraphs: Engine rebuilding takes place at our workshop in Ramsden Heath, Billericay. Customers can arrange a booked arrival or discuss optional mainland UK collection and delivery, subject to availability and a separate transport quote.

Tell us whether the vehicle starts, turns over, rolls and can be accessed for recovery. Provide the location and any restrictions before booking. A vehicle with a severe pressure warning, timing concern or mechanical noise should not be driven simply to reach the workshop.

Removal/refitting scope follows the actual installation and written quote. Already-removed engines, unusual conversions and previous dismantling should be discussed individually rather than assumed to match a standard installed-rebuild guide.

paragraphs: Covered rebuild components and associated workmanship have a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, subject to the full conditions. Excluded ancillaries are not covered simply because the engine has been rebuilt.

The chargeable running-in service at 2,000 miles, within the stated 200-mile tolerance, must be completed at Boby's workshop. The published terms state that missing it voids the warranty. Read the conditions before booking; statutory rights are unaffected. Discuss towing, hire, modifications or track use before agreeing the work and applicable cover.
Read the warranty and full terms. Completion schedules are discussed for the actual repair and can change with strip-down findings, machining or parts availability.
